dedupe_keys.name: ltspice photovoltaic cell shading and open short circuit simulation dataset

description: This dataset contains simulated electrical responses of ten Spectrolab GaAs/Ge single-junction photovoltaic cells under different configurations, temperatures, lighting conditions and faults. The California State University Fullerton team generated the cases with Python and LTSpice using a two-diode equivalent circuit, motivated by photovoltaic power for small autonomous devices. Mendeley publishes three CSV files for combined, shading and special cases, free under CC BY 4.0. The records are synthetic parameter sweeps without an observation calendar or representative geographic sample. They describe a particular cell technology and circuit assumptions, so they do not establish field failure rates or full solar-farm behaviour. A reviewer-assessed use is testing fault-sensitive photovoltaic component responses within energy simulations. model-system-advisor-model-sam is a related system-level photovoltaic model, with a different scale and input structure. The article specifications give an additional IEEE identifier, but the verified resource identity here is the named Mendeley deposit. No CSV was downloaded.
